# 12. Facilitator Reflection {.unnumbered}

There will be no mindset this week. Instead, you will reflect on your facilitation of the team
discussion.

## Reflect and Plan

::: {.callout-warning}
## Journal
- **Reflect:** How did your team discussion go? What worked, what was hard, and what did you
  learn about yourself as a facilitator?
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## UGPM Meeting
Debrief your facilitation with the group, drawing on what you noticed during and after the
team discussion.
:::
